name: Light Console (control)
description: Light Console controls the configured RGBW and relay boards. Configure distinct random LIGHT_CONSOLE_READ_TOKEN and LIGHT_CONSOLE_CONTROL_TOKEN environment variables (at least 32 characters each) on the Light Console process and restart it. Never put credentials in this file. Set this API's base URL to the address reachable from the Erinne server, not localhost unless both services run on the same host. Use an HTTPS reverse proxy when sending credentials across a network; Light Console itself serves HTTP. For a private certificate, compare the SHA-256 fingerprint with the certificate on the proxy before pinning it in Access > APIs. On that host: openssl x509 -in server.crt -noout -fingerprint -sha256. Assign your lighting operators' AD group in Erinne. Responses contain configured light names, IDs, telemetry and timestamps; names may identify private rooms. Leave Claude access off unless those names may be sent to Anthropic. Discover IDs with List lights; never infer them from example questions. An RGBW light may list named zones (for example Left and Right): pass that zone number to change one, or leave zone empty to change every zone together. Relay lights cannot change color. A 202 response means queued, not physically confirmed. Check Light state after changes; reported RGBW telemetry can be retained/stale, while relay power is only the last command. Paste LIGHT_CONSOLE_CONTROL_TOKEN as this separate entry's Bearer credential. Every operation is an action: Erinne proposes it and the person presses Run it. Enable the read template too so the assistant can discover IDs and capabilities.

operations.name: Set light color
operations.description: Set any color-capable light's complete RGBW output, on every zone or on one named zone. Discover its ID and zones first. Red/green/blue are required integers; white defaults to zero. Relay lights are rejected.

params.name: light_id
params.help: Exact light ID from List lights; match the requested name first

params.name: w
params.help: Dedicated white intensity, 0 off to 255 full

params.name: zone
params.help: Zone number from the light's zones in List lights (e.g. the Left zone); leave empty to change every zone together

example_questions: Change the desk strip to warm orange.
Set the RGBW light to purple with white off.
Make only the left side of the room red.

operations.name: Set light channel
operations.description: Change one RGBW channel while preserving the others on a color-capable light, on every zone or on one named zone; use only for a specifically requested channel adjustment.

params.name: light_id
params.help: Exact light ID from List lights; match the requested name first

params.name: zone
params.help: Zone number from the light's zones in List lights (e.g. the Left zone); leave empty to change every zone together

example_questions: Set only the white channel to 128.
Turn off just the red channel.
Raise the blue channel to 200 without changing the others.
Set green to full on the desk strip.
Dim the white channel on the right zone to 40.

operations.name: Set light power
operations.description: Turn any configured light on or off, or one zone of an RGBW light. RGBW on explicitly sets full dedicated white (RGB zero); it does not restore a previous color. Relay on/off switches its power; relays have no zones.

params.name: light_id
params.help: Exact light ID from List lights; match the requested name first

params.name: zone
params.help: Zone number from the light's zones in List lights (e.g. the Left zone); leave empty to change every zone together

example_questions: Turn the RGBW strip on with full white.
Turn off just the right side.
